annotations.title: Get a step-by-step recipe for a common job

description: Step-by-step recipes with the exact tool calls and arguments for common jobs: put a stream (player and chat) on a website, a password-protected broadcast for employees, a radio station on a company website, restream to YouTube/Twitch/Facebook, sell access, a video website with a paid subscription, upload or import a video, webhooks and status polling. Call without recipe_id to list them. Follow the steps in order and use the embed codes and addresses the tools return instead of writing your own.

recipe_id.description: Recipe id; omit to list all recipes
